successful_patterns.pattern: Transfer from the behavioral_full set works: 34/40 of its best constructs re-expressed in canonical OHLCV+VWAP+AMOUNT clear the 0.03 gates
successful_patterns.evidence: cR1: every champion survives — hl_med60 0.094 OOS, max20 0.091, gapvol 0.085, aggrmax 0.083, ret_on_hivol60 (volume-conditioned) 0.082, semivol120 0.079, volclock 0.076. Conditional and masked-asym constructs translate with VOLUME conditions.

successful_patterns.pattern: Novel canonical-only constructs mint beyond transfer: nvol conditionals/asymmetries, 120d tiers, robust medians
successful_patterns.evidence: cR2: id_on_hivol120 OOS 0.081, hl_updown60 0.070, attn_up_cnt120 0.065, ret_hl_corr120 0.063, aggr_min60 0.063, gapmed120, signed_nvol both bands, nvol_burst both bands. The volume-normalized (nvol) framing supports the whole conditional/asym/event portfolio even though RegBeta on it is dead.

successful_patterns.pattern: Main-set band-coexistence patterns replicate: semivol60, min60, aggrmax60, aggr_updown 20/60, hl bursts, gapmed20 all clear next to siblings; gap-crash magnitude is new
successful_patterns.evidence: cR3: min_gap60 (quarterly deepest gap-down) OOS -0.064 — a construct the main set never accepted (20d version died there); nvol_spike 0.052 (turn_spike analog), lag2 both bands in.

successful_patterns.pattern: Conditional RANGE is a novel first-class construct: range on high-attention days
successful_patterns.evidence: cR4: hl_on_hivol 0.078 / hl_on_hivol60 0.081 OOS — passed despite hlmed60 resident (conditional masking decorrelates from the level); semivol250 and id_on_hivol250 extend the 250d tier.

successful_patterns.pattern: Conditional returns on wide-RANGE days is the set's best factor; aggression asymmetry completes to 120d
successful_patterns.evidence: cR5: ret_on_hiHL120 OOS 0.0921 (set-wide best); aggr_updown120 0.052. The condition variable matters: RANGE-conditioned returns beat VOLUME-conditioned (0.092 vs 0.081).

cR10: hl_med_dev_sm (10d-smoothed range/median deviation) accepted at IS 0.041/OOS 0.034 where the raw daily version was 0.026 — first factor gated by the upgraded stage 4 (rolling 1.00, bootstrap p=0.000). Set: 80 individual factors.

successful_patterns.pattern: NOVEL VEIN (experiment run 1): joint-condition day-type counts — gap-direction x intraday-direction
successful_patterns.evidence: cR11: dipbuy_freq (count of gap-down-close-up days, 60d) IS -0.041/-0.55, OOS -0.064 (stronger OOS), 3/3 universes, max corr 0.63 — heavily dip-bought names underperform (dip-buying marks distribution). fade_freq passed S1-S3, OOS 0.024 just under; near-misses: aggr_on_gapdn 0.029, gap_sign_bal120 ICIR 0.52/IC 0.024.

successful_patterns.pattern: Day-type vein 2-for-2 (experiment run 2): aggression-on-day-type is its own mintable construct
successful_patterns.evidence: cR12: aggr_dipbuy (closing aggression on gap-down-close-up days) IS 0.070/0.68, OOS 0.068, corr 0.59. Strong raw signals corr-lock: dipbuy_mag IS 0.076 but 0.74 vs med_band60, dipbuy_hivol 0.71 vs hl_on_hivol; vwap_recover 0.76 vs the new dipbuy_freq. Fade side consistently JUST under OOS bar (fade_share -0.024 + 2/3 uni, fade_freq120 -0.021): real but weak.

successful_patterns.pattern: Day-type vein 4 accepts in 3 runs; MAGNITUDE-on-type beats COUNT-of-type
successful_patterns.evidence: cR13: gap_dipmag (depth of bought dips) IS 0.072/0.60 -> OOS 0.082, best of experiment; aggr_capit OOS -0.064. Counts increasingly corr-lock (accum_freq 0.74, aggr_dipbuy120 0.78 vs its own 60d) — the marginal space is in per-type magnitudes/textures.

successful_patterns.pattern: Day-type magnitudes: 3 more accepts (7 total in 4 runs); the vein now self-locks at S2
successful_patterns.evidence: cR14: gap_capitmag OOS 0.078, nvol_dipbuy OOS 0.070/ICIR 0.78, dipbuy_freq20 -0.053. S1 pass 9/12 — but hl-on-type collides with hlmed60 (0.76-0.78) and capitulation magnitudes collide with each other (0.82-0.84). Normalizing typed textures by their own base level may unlock.

successful_patterns.pattern: EXPERIMENT VERDICT (5 runs, 73 candidates): novelty IS still findable — 8 accepts, ALL from one vein (joint-condition day-types) that no prior round had touched
successful_patterns.evidence: cR11-15: dipbuy_freq 60/20, aggr_dipbuy, aggr_capit, gap_dipmag (OOS 0.082), gap_capitmag (0.078), nvol_dipbuy, nvol_capit (0.055). The generator pattern that worked: define day TYPES from joint gap/intraday conditions, then aggregate {count, magnitude, aggression, attention} OVER typed days. Everything outside the vein failed (0/30+): elasticities, shape ratios, bar patterns, durations, wildcards.

successful_patterns.pattern: Extended campaign R16 (40 cand): THREE new classes minted — true gaps, volume-at-extremes, vwap-pin stalemates
successful_patterns.evidence: cR16 (5/40): vwap_pin_freq (closes pinned to vwap = stalemate days) OOS -0.070 best; truegap_dn_freq 0.044 + island_up_freq 0.044 (range-breaking/unfilled gaps); vol_at_low -0.041 + vol_ext_asym 0.040 (Wyckoff volume-at-extremes). S1 pass 15/40 — richest since transfer.

successful_patterns.pattern: R17 (7/40): set reaches 100 individual factors; near-miss THRESHOLD/WINDOW jitters revive dead classes
successful_patterns.evidence: cR17: pin_freq20 -0.061, aggr_at_high 0.053, nvol_truegap 0.048, ma_pin_tight -0.048 (MA-pin revived by tightening 0.01->0.005), vol_accel60 0.042 (acceleration revived at monthly ratio), truegap_dn250 0.040, vol_at_gapext 0.034. Lesson: when a class shows ICIR-viability with IC just under, jitter the THRESHOLD not just the window.

successful_patterns.pattern: R18 (5/40, campaign end): at-EVENT textures are the deepest of the new classes; day-level anchors (best day) work where price anchors died
successful_patterns.evidence: cR18: hl_at_best (range on the month's best day) OOS 0.070/ICIR 0.75; aggr_ext_asym 0.046; updn_amt_ratio (dollar share on up days) 0.047; id_pin_freq (doji count) -0.048; nvol_at_best 0.035. Extended campaign total: 17/120 (14%) — classes minted: pins/stalemates, true gaps, at-extreme/at-event textures, acceleration, dollar-share.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: RegBeta elasticity constructs on self-normalized volume (nvol = VOLUME/TsMean) — the free-float normalization of turnover was load-bearing
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR1: c_elasticity ICIR 0.03, c_fragility -0.07 (as turnover versions: 0.83 and 0.65). Correlation-style couplings survive self-normalization; regression betas do not. Also c_ret_nvol_corr deduped into c_vol_updown (0.7+), c_ovnshare OOS 0.018, c_vwapdev 2/3 universes, c_volterm IC 0.027 under the modern bar.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: nvol couplings with RANGE/GAP/AGGRESSION partners die at S1 (unlike TURN versions in the main set); candle event-framing doesn't rescue the family
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR2: hl_nvol_corr 0.34/IC 0.019, gap_nvol_corr 0.41/0.022, aggr_nvol_corr 0.42/0.024 — all ICIR-viable but IC under 0.03 (turnover carried more cross-sectional information than self-normalized volume for these); reject_freq 0.08; gap_hl_corr -0.09. S2/S3: hlmed20~hlmed60 0.85, ret_namt~ret_nvol-family 0.76, ret_on_hivol120 dup of id_on_hivol120.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Longer-band rescues that DON'T work: meanmed 60/120 (IC<0.03), idmed120, hlterm_slow, hl_nvol_corr even at 120d, ret_on_lovol120, upday-share ratios; 250d-adjacent and max120/rev120/gapvol60 die at S2 vs their siblings
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR3 S1: meanmed60 0.027, meanmed120 0.025, hl_nvol_corr120 IC 0.015 (the range-attention coupling is dead at every band in canonical vocab). S2: max120~max60-family 0.72, rev120~rev-family 0.70, gapvol60~gapvol 0.74, nvolmax~volcv 0.70, illiq_term~zeroret -0.87. S4: pvcorr60 OOS 0.019, gap_on_hivol120 0.013 (gap conditionals dead at all tiers).

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Robust-deviation class (X vs own median) under the bar; gap asymmetry dead at every band; candle constructs closed in all framings
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR4 S1: hl_med_dev 0.026, nvol_med_dev 0.021, gap_updown60 0.010, close_pos_med 0.012, range_stud -0.021. Near-misses for jitter retries: ovnmom20 0.028, vwap_gap_med 0.032/0.29, aggr_sum60 0.028, updn_freq_hl 0.027/0.30.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Conditional-on-attention variants mostly collide with residents now (6 S2 kills at 0.71-0.85); quiet-day complements and drought/efficiency probes dead
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR5: hl_on_down~hlmed60 0.76, max_on_hivol~max20 0.85, id_on_hiHL60~rev20 0.84, gapvol_on_hivol~gapvol 0.71; hl_on_lovol 0.08, nvol_min -0.10, travel_eff 0.06 at S1; wma_cross and ret_asym_cnt both at ICIR 0.30 borderline again; hl_cv OOS 0.023, att_autocorr 0.028 (S4 near-misses -> 120d/60d jitter retries).

forbidden_patterns.pattern: SATURATION: the canonical vocabulary vs 79 residents at corr<0.70 is exhausted — jitter retries and novel forms alike die at S1 (weak) or S2 (0.71-0.94)
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR6: 1/18 accepted (ret_on_hiHL250 OOS 0.082). S2 kills at 0.71-0.94 include structurally distinct ideas (tail_ratio~aggr_min 0.75, vol_on_down120~signed 0.94); S4 near-misses persist (att_autocorr60 0.021, nvol_burst250 0.020, hl_cv120 0.015). Rounds 5-6 yielded 2 then 1 -> saturation rule triggered, escalated to user.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Individual-factor space in canonical vocabulary is EXHAUSTED: strong new constructs are corr-locked, novel asymmetries are dead
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR10 (1/19): awvol/awmove IS 0.073-0.075 but 0.77-0.78 vs volterm resident; vwapgap_vol 0.073 but 0.88 vs gapvol; gap_abs_med 0.062 but 0.77 vs hlmed60; att_span 0.89 vs hl_on_hivol; asymmetric Amihud 0.10-0.13 ICIR, ovnshare_updown -0.08, hl_slope/persist under bar; band jitters (vwapgap_med40, zeroret180, ovnmom30, aggr_sum90, updn_freq_hl90, gapdn_freq120, idmed5) all S1/S2. Further growth needs new fields, a different label horizon, or relaxed corr thresholds — not more formulas.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Cross-quantity elasticities, shape ratios, distribution shape on non-return quantities, duration measures — all dead
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR11: range_att_beta 0.11, gap_att_beta 0.32/IC 0.019, vol/gap clustering -0.44/-0.45 but |IC| ~0.02, burst-amplitude ratios 0.18-0.37 with IC under bar (nvol_burst_amp passed S1 then died S4: OOS 0.011, year 0.71), hl_skew -0.14, nvol_kurt 0.05, above_med_dur 0.15, amihud_med 0.14.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Day-type ratios/balances/post-returns and gap one-sidedness at any window
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR12 S1: dipbuy_share 0.25, capit_share -0.18, daytype_bal 0.31/IC 0.020, capit_freq 0.25, post_dipbuy_ret 0.19, vwap_fail -0.29, aggr_on_gapdn60 0.23, gap_sign_bal 180/250 ICIR 0.43-0.44 but IC 0.021-0.022 (the construct never clears the IC bar at any window).

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Bar patterns (inside/outside days), churn days, quiet-drift, breakout-with-volume, fade-side anything
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR13 S1: inside 0.17, outside 0.08, churn 0.38 ICIR but IC 0.019, quiet_up 0.13, breakout_vol 0.27/0.031 near-miss, aggr_fade -0.22, fade_mag -0.15, bigdip_buy120 0.40/0.019, dist_days120 0.29. The fade/capitulation-count side never clears; only aggression/magnitude ON those days does.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Fade-side magnitudes (4th consecutive failure), signed gap*id covariance sums, breakout counts at any band
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR14 S1: gap_fademag 0.17, gapid_covmag 0.43 ICIR/0.027 IC, breakout_vol120 0.15. The fade/gap-up-failure side of the day-type grammar does not price at 10d.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Vein saturation reached in run 5: normalization does NOT break S2 self-locks; typed liquidity/recency/efficiency dead
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR15: hl_dipbuy_norm ICIR 0.93 (!) but 0.85 corr vs dipbuy_freq (normalizing by own median range does not decorrelate); capit_rel_depth 0.27, recover_eff 0.18, amihud_dipbuy 0.04, dipbuy_rec 0.12, dollar_depth 0.17, gap_kurt 0.05; range_eff_med passed S1-S3 then OOS 0.019. The day-type vein is ~fully harvested at corr<0.70.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Dead classes (R16): zone occupancy, peak asynchrony, MA-duration, round trips, acceleration, triple-condition day-types; week-runs and truegap magnitudes corr-locked
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR16: asynchrony ~0; occupancy 0.10-0.27; roundtrips -0.32/0.026; accel 0.33-0.34/IC ~0.028; capitrev/silent_crash/quiet_capit ~0.1. S2: week-runs 0.70-0.77 vs max_eff, truegap mags 0.73-0.84 vs gapmed/mingap, blowoff 0.75, heavy-dip variants 0.73-0.80.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Pin family: only plain counts work (conditioned pins all dead); typed true-gap sub-events and at-extreme textures thin out fast
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR17 S1: contested/wide/lazy/gap/after-run pins -0.10 to -0.31 with IC under; pin 120/250 ICIR 0.28-0.29 (long-window pins decay); island_dn, tg_up_faded ~0; hl/gap/id-at-extremes 0.09-0.13. S2: lazy_pin 0.82 vs pin20, truegap_dn120 0.80, island_mag 0.91 vs island count.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Jitter has limits: pin threshold variants corr-lock to the parent; acceleration variants collapse into vol_accel60; second-tier jitters of dead classes stay dead
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR18 S2 kills: pin_tight/pin_loose/max_fortnight_run/vol_at_high10/id_at_high/vwap_drift/hl_accel120/amt_accel/vol_accel_q all 0.70+ vs residents; S1: occupancy/roundtrip/ma-band re-jitters, amihud_asym60, range_per_vol, quiet_range, loud_still, wildcards all under. The 8-field space after 18 rounds: ~one new CLASS per 40-candidate sweep, 2-5 factors per class before self-lock.
